enterprise.stopped: This page can’t open: your organization’s settings ask for features that need a key, and none here unlocks them. Tell your IT team.
retention.title: Kept for your organization
retention.text: Your organization keeps each task, with its certificates, for at least {duration}. What you delete, or remove by asking something again, stays on this device until then, out of sight.
retention.failed: Nothing was removed: your organization keeps a copy of what goes first, and this time it couldn’t be made.
retention.profile: This profile stays: your organization keeps each task for at least {duration}, and removing a profile would delete its tasks.
